Annotation-management screen requirements developed across sessions. On 2023-05-20, the user requested task-management use cases and a functional specification for a Specific Task screen and annotation tool; proposed capabilities covered task/document details, progress, statuses, tagger/checker assignment, annotation, review, approval, rejection, and accessibility (T1–T9). On 2023-05-26, the user expanded Tasks-screen requirements to include editing and reallocating tasks, document reassignment, checker review and revision requests, completion when all documents are complete, notifications, history, conflict resolution, progress tracking, label suggestions, messaging, version control, quality metrics, custom labels, imports/exports, optional fields, and visualizations (T344–T357). The assistant drafted a role-based functional specification; Taggers finish documents into Review, and Checkers approve, reject, or request changes. The latest state is a broad proposed specification, not evidence of implementation.

They considered the Wildlife Management Association program a possible fit and asked about a Wildlife Management Plan and pond habitat practices. They were particularly interested in prescribed burning; the assistant described planning, firebreaks, suitable weather, monitoring, and cleanup, and advised consulting a TPWD biologist. No enrollment, plan, or burn was confirmed.
